neighbours.label: the word in the scope of a restrictive 'only' / 'but' (only real once, but an inferior person)
fire: The village is only reachable by boat in winter.
He insisted the injury was only bruised, not broken.
The old radio only works when you hit it twice.
She claimed the painting was only copied from a postcard.
These mushrooms are only edible after long cooking.
The bridge is only open to cyclists on Sundays.
They said the ghost was only seen at midnight.
The seeds only sprout when the soil is warm.
quiet: The village is easily reachable by boat in winter.
He insisted the injury was badly bruised, not broken.
The old radio still works when you hit it twice.
She claimed the painting was carefully copied from a postcard.
These mushrooms are perfectly edible after long cooking.
The bridge is also open to cyclists on Sundays.
They said the ghost was often seen at midnight.
The seeds quickly sprout when the soil is warm.

notes: Broad pole (1% of tokens > 0.1 max). Card: words after 'only'/'but an' (inferior, real, criminals, fainted and). Logit effect suppresses ' merely'/' only'/' few'. Probe: 0.18-0.38 on the 'only X' item, 0.01 when 'only' is removed; 'only a child' 0.09.
